Issue 23091 and 23092 in oss-fuzz: divide by zero and uninitialized value * Also changed enhance_fuzzer to use Spix input.

Fix oss-fuzz issue 24134: dewarp_fuzzer: rasterop buffer overflow. * The bitblit (rasterop) operations gave the correct result, because the   bits read from a word beyond the image were masked out and not used.   But the memory sanitizers (e.g., valgrand) noticed the read error. * This also fixed an illegal 4 byte read (leptonica issue #534),   found by Nam Le Duc. * Also fix pix4_fuzzer.c. * Also remove unused variables from 4 prog functions. * Add instructions for building fuzzers to README.html.

Simplify fpixCopy() and dpixCopy() * only allow new image * removed fpixResizeImageData() and dpixResizeImageData(). * simplified fpixEndianByteSwap() and dpixEndianByteSwap() * simplified fpixLinearCombination() and dpixLinearCombination() * simplified fpixRotate180(), fpixFlipLR() and fpixFlipTB() * modified fpix2_fuzzer.cc

Fix oss-fuzz issue 27691: dewarp_fuzzer: uninit value in genPathname * do proper arg checking in getFilenamesInDirectory() * don't ask for debug output with fuzzer
New function that uniformly concatenates sets of strings in an sarray. * added test in prog/string_reg.c
Oss-fuzz issue 29117: finditalic_fuzzer: heap overflow * substituteObjectNumbers() was not checking array bounds * also fixed enhance_fuzzer.cc * also fixed documentation in enhance.c

Fix issue 29819: Heap-buffer-overflow in fdilate_1_56 * Illegal use of a function; fix documentation to reflect this. * Fix some bugs in flipdetect_fuzzer and pix3_fuzzer. * Limit size of sel generated from a template pix. * Remove large output data in dwamorph1_reg, unless display is requested * Added new reg test: binmorph6_reg.c

Remove all dwa code for flip detection. * This has didactic value, but it's not even twice as fast as rasterop   morphology.  On a 8 Mpixel image, rasterop is 0.37 sec, dwa is 0.21. * So the added complexity is not worth the cost, especially for this   single case application. * The dwa code, including that in fliphmtgen.c, has been put in a   new file: flipdetectdwa.c.notused; it is not compiled in the library. * Likewise, the file prog/flipselgen.c is renamed flipselgen.c.notused,   and is no longer compiled in. * prog/flipdetect_reg.c is now an actual regression test.
In fopenTiffMemstream(), catch failure to open the stream. Also fix fuzzing/boxafunc5_fuzzer.cc, which has out-of-date functions.
Attempt to fix oss-fuzz issue 42151 * Also remove preprocessor conditionals in prog/cleanpdf.c

Fix oss-fuzz issue 43841: overflow in pixCountPixels() in pix3_fuzzer.cc * Caused by illegal pointer in the fuzzer program for tab8. * Also fixed the cropping in pixCountPixelsInRect().  It was allowing   an arbitrarily large pix to be made.  No error in counting, but a   waste of heap memory.
